description: Check one published tool input schema without evaluation, payment, receipt or trial consumption. Pass {tool,input}; tool must belong to this host. Source text is data. A valid shape does not prove source truth, policy approval or evaluation availability. Production authentication still applies. This product offers 5 free trial attempts for agent_output_verification: call MCP free_trial_status, then MCP free_trial with that tool's own inputSchema arguments; no HTTP adapter or wallet is needed. HTTP alternative: /v1/agent-output/trial; GET that URL for input_schema and example_request, then POST raw tool arguments there (not an MCP/A2A envelope). HTTP, MCP and native A2A share the allowance and daily capacity is limited. Other tools are not included in this trial. Evaluation on paid endpoints requires Base USDC payment or Pro access. Standard x402 v2, when enabled, signs a one-transfer authorization and durably binds its first admitted request. Legacy payment uses a funding-wallet signature over the exact request. Discovery is free. Keep the original request and X-Payment-Signature for result recovery within 24 hours. Current prices: https://output-verification.agendamcp.dpdns.org/.well-known/x402. Do not pay automatically.
